تقترعي (form VIII)
# تَقْتَرِعِي (taqtariʕī) /taq.ta.ri.ʕiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
# تُقْتَرَعِي (tuqtaraʕī) /tuq.ta.ra.ʕiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
